method: Pack two KV heads along the attention key-column axis with an explicit cross-head mask, keeping head dimension64. Each valid head attends to every key. This avoids the doubled128-wide accumulator of the earlier rejected pair2d design.
precision: FP8 Q/cache and BF16 probabilities/value dot, same as control.
decision: No promotion. Do not repeat paired-head layouts without distinct evidence.
